CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /usr/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import csv,json
from decimal import Decimal,localcontext
from pathlib import Path
import polars as pl

story=Path('/root/embedding-optimizer-story-refactor')
result=Path('/tmp/dense-v3-benchmark-support.LtaKgNMD/actual')
def read_csv(path):
    with path.open() as handle:
        return list(csv.DictReader(handle))
receipt=json.loads((result/'readout.json').read_text())
source=read_csv(Path(receipt['evaluation_root'])/'tables/final-checkpoints/task-scores.csv')
assert len(source)==168
by={(r['run_id'],r['task']):Decimal(r['ndcg_at_10']) for r in source}
assert len(by)==168
selected=receipt['selected']
runs={o:sorted({run for run,task in by if run.startswith('verified-v3-'+o+'-')}) for o in ('adamw','muon','normuon')}
assert all(len(v)==4 for v in runs.values())
rows=read_csv(result/'task_contributions.csv')
summary=read_csv(result/'contrast_summary.csv')
assert len(rows)==84 and len(summary)==6
by_contrast={}
with localcontext() as ctx:
    ctx.prec=60
    for row in rows:
        family,treatment,baseline,task=(row[k] for k in ('family','treatment','baseline','task'))
        def mean(optimizer):
            members=runs[optimizer] if family=='primary' else [selected[optimizer]]
            return sum(by[run,task] for run in members)/Decimal(len(members))
        delta=(mean(treatment)-mean(baseline))*100
        def rational(text):
            terms=text.split('/')
            return Decimal(terms[0])/(Decimal(terms[1]) if len(terms)==2 else 1)
        assert delta==rational(row['exact_task_delta'])
        contribution=delta/14
        assert abs(contribution-rational(row['exact_macro_contribution']))<Decimal('1e-58')
        assert abs(contribution-Decimal(row['macro_contribution_points']))<Decimal('2e-15')
        by_contrast.setdefault((family,treatment,baseline),[]).append((task,delta,contribution))
    for row in summary:
        key=tuple(row[k] for k in ('family','treatment','baseline'))
        parts=by_contrast[key]
        assert len(parts)==14
        mean=sum(p[1] for p in parts)/14
        assert abs(mean-Decimal(row['macro_delta_points']))<Decimal('2e-15')
        assert int(row['positive_tasks'])==sum(p[1]>0 for p in parts)
        assert int(row['negative_tasks'])==sum(p[1]<0 for p in parts)
        assert int(row['tied_tasks'])==sum(p[1]==0 for p in parts)
    for treatment,taskset in (('muon',{'NQ'}),('normuon',{'NQ','Touche2020'})):
        parts=by_contrast['secondary',treatment,'adamw']
        net=sum(p[2] for p in parts)
        subset=sum(p[2] for p in parts if p[0] in taskset)
        print(json.dumps({'treatment':treatment,'tasks':sorted(taskset),'macro_contribution_points':str(subset),'net_macro_delta_points':str(net),'fraction_of_net_macro_delta':str(subset/net)}))

sizes=read_csv(result/'benchmark_sizes.csv')
assert len(sizes)==14
bindings={(r['task'],r['repo_path']):r for r in receipt['query_qrel_file_bindings']}
for row in sizes:
    task=row['task']
    def file(name):
        b=bindings[task,name]
        return str(Path(receipt['hf_cache'])/('datasets--'+b['repo'].replace('/','--'))/'blobs'/b['sha256'])
    queries=pl.read_parquet(file('queries.parquet'),columns=['_id'])
    name='qrels_validation.parquet' if row['split']=='dev' else 'qrels_test.parquet'
    qrels=pl.read_parquet(file(name),columns=['query-id','score'])
    covered=qrels['query-id'].n_unique()
    positive=qrels.filter(pl.col('score')>0)['query-id'].n_unique()
    actual={'query_file_rows':queries.height,'qrel_rows':qrels.height,'qrel_covered_queries':covered,'queries_with_positive_qrel':positive,'queries_without_positive_qrel':covered-positive}
    assert all(actual[k]==int(row[k]) for k in actual)
print(json.dumps({'independent_decimal_native_table_rows':len(source),'task_contribution_rows_checked':len(rows),'contrast_sign_summaries_checked':len(summary),'independent_polars_benchmark_tasks_checked':len(sizes),'query_count_fields_checked':70,'polars_version':pl.__version__,'model_execution':False,'new_inference':False,'passed':True}))
